
```{r}
#raster/vector interactions

if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")

pacman::p_load(tidyverse,
               sf,
               terra,
               tidyterra,
               exactextractr)


sf_site<- readRDS("data/sf_finsync_nc.rds")
sf_nc_county<-readRDS("data/sf_nc_county.rds")
spr_prec_nc<-rast("data/spr_prec_nc.tif")

#point-wise extraction

ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data=spr_prec_nc)+
  scale_fill_viridis_c()

extract(x=spr_prec_nc,y=sf_site,bind=TRUE)%>%st_as_sf()


#zonal statistics

sf_nc_county_proj<-st_transform(sf_nc_county,crs=32617)

spr_prec_nc_proj<-project(x=spr_prec_nc,y=crs(sf_nc_county_proj))


ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data=spr_prec_nc)+
  geom_sf(data=sf_nc_county,
          alpha=0.25)

df_prec_county<-exact_extract(
  x=spr_prec_nc_proj,
  y=sf_nc_county_proj,fun="mean",
  append_cols="county") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  rename(precipitation=mean)

sf_nc_county_prec<-sf_nc_county %>% 
  left_join(df_prec_county,
            by="county")

#visualize the map with precipitation
#aes(fill=precipitation)


ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=sf_nc_county_prec,
          aes(fill=precipitation))+
  scale_fill_viridis_c()



#which county had the lowest precipitation

sf_nc_county_prec %>% arrange(precipitation)

#buffer-based analysis

sf_site_proj<-sf_site %>% st_transform(crs=32617)

sf_site_buff_proj<-sf_site_proj %>% st_buffer(dist=10000)

#visualize the sf_site_buff_proj and sf_site_proj together

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=sf_site_buff_proj)+
  geom_sf(data=sf_site_proj)

#calculate mean precipitation in each polygon
df_prec_buff<-exact_extract(
  x=spr_prec_nc_proj,
  y=sf_site_buff_proj,
  fun="mean",
  append_cols="site_id") %>% 
  as_tibble()%>%
  rename(precipitation=mean)

df_prec_buff <- exact_extract(
  x = spr_prec_nc_proj,
  y = sf_site_buff_proj,
  fun = "mean",
  append_cols = "site_id") %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  rename(precipitation = mean)




sf_site_prec_buff<-sf_site %>% 
  left_join(
    df_prec_buff,
    by="site_id")

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=sf_nc_county)+
  geom_sf(data=sf_site_prec_buff,
          aes(color=precipitation))+
  scale_color_viridis_c()

#exercise--------------------------------------------------------------------
#0 = everything else
# 1001 = forest
# 1010 = crop
# 1100 = urban

spr_land<-rast("data/spr_land_reclass.tif")

#Q1 
cm<-cbind(
  c(0,1001,1010,1100),
  c(0,0,1,0)
)

spr_crop<-classify(
  x=spr_land,
  rcl=cm
)


#Q2
spr_crop_proj<-project(x=spr_crop,
                       y=crs(sf_nc_county_proj))


df_crop<-exact_extract(
  x=spr_crop_proj,
  y=sf_nc_county_proj,
  fun="mean",
  append_cols="county"
) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  rename(frac_crop=mean)


#Q3
arrange(df_crop,desc(frac_crop))

#Q4
(sf_nc_county_crop<-sf_nc_county %>% 
    left_join(df_crop,
              by="county"))

ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=sf_nc_county_crop,
          aes(fill=frac_crop))+
  scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  theme_bw()
```
